description: Send each DataFrame row to an Azure Service Bus queue or topic as a JSON message. Mirrors dataframe_to_eventhub for SB workloads — completes the registry's existing servicebus_monitor + servicebus_to_database_asset (consumer) pair.

connection_string_env_var.description: Env var holding the SB namespace or queue/topic-scoped connection string
connection_string_env_var.label: Connection String Env Var

destination_name.description: Queue or topic name (the SB entity to send to)
destination_name.label: Destination Name

session_id_column.description: Optional column to use as Session ID. Required if the queue/topic has sessions enabled — guarantees per-session ordering.
session_id_column.label: Session Id Column

message_id_column.description: Optional column to use as Message ID for idempotency / dedup.
message_id_column.label: Message Id Column

correlation_id_column.description: Optional column to use as Correlation ID (for request/reply patterns).
correlation_id_column.label: Correlation Id Column

batch_size.description: Max messages per ServiceBusMessageBatch. SB enforces a 256KB batch byte cap (or 1MB on Premium); the SDK splits batches automatically.
batch_size.label: Batch Size

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds
